Results.ReviewText: This is an excellent Grill.  Assembly wasn't difficult, and the build quality is great.  I experienced an issue with the propane hose out of the box, and my initial thought was to rate it 4 Stars.  However, Webers customer service was superior to most companies I've dealt with and a new (replacement) hose was shipped promptly.  They even offered to have me purchase a hose locally and send them the bill for reimbursement.  THAT is customer service. Aside from that, what I love about this Grill is the even heat that is distributed across the burner design.  Everything grills similarly across the entire grill grate.  I would definitely purchase this grill again, definitely a WEBER.
Results.Title: Couldn't be happier with my Spirit II Weber Grill!

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
